title: 7 Days to Die

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · The Fun Pimps build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Space held for curator writing on 7 Days to Die as a long-lived Steam survival holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title.
preservation.concerns: As with other account-bound Steam holdings: platform dependency, policy change, and the absence of a retained offline installer.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam 1.0 release dated July 25, 2024. Earlier Early Access builds on Steam date from December 2013; this filing records the licensed digital edition in present custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

steam.shortDescription: 7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!

synopsis: The Fun Pimps’ 7 Days to Die on Steam — a survival sandbox holding retained in permanent digital custody.
